verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs list SDK features (exec, files, sessions, tunnels, VM isolation) but never state or document actual cold-start latency numbers for sandboxes. Community discussion only speculates about Cloudflare's boot time, with commenters uncertain whether it's fast and comparing it unfavorably to other Firecracker-based startups (20-50ms) — no first-party benchmark or documented cold-start figure exists in the evidence.
